verdict.rationale: Firebase's core Realtime Database/Firestore offering is built around realtime listeners that push data changes to clients without polling, confirmed by docs (firebase-docs-28, firebase-docs-3) and corroborated by hands-on community accounts of building real-time apps quickly (firebase-comm-5, firebase-comm-17). Missing for 10: no independent benchmark or deep technical breakdown of listener scaling/latency limits beyond anecdotal praise.
